card.fires_on: Words inside descriptions of an astrology star chart, such as the Horizon, ASC, MC, DSC and 'rising stars'. It fires on ordinary words like 'about', 'reveal' and 'your' in these sentences.

modes.label: Words after 'stars conjoining'
modes.description: Linking words in sentences saying the stars at a chart point reveal much about a person.
modes.example: The stars conjoining your ASC are your "rising stars" and reveal much<< about>> the nature of your soul expression on Earth

modes.label: Chart geometry terms
modes.description: Words describing the Horizon, Equator and labeled points of a star chart.
modes.example: the most northern point from Earth's Equator (<<l>>abeled N)
